title: Nine Feet and a Wall
subtitle: 假定与设想 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 假定与设想（人与自我·思维与判断）
meta: 主题语境：假定与设想（人与自我·思维与判断）　|　核心词汇：assumption　|　正文 316 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 assumption 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 my father made ① an assumption about a wall, that it was his, and it cost him nine years and a fence. The ② assumption, meaning the belief and not the wall, had been wrong since 1961 and nobody had tested it; an assumption, he said, is a fact that has never been asked for its papers. He said the papers turned up in June.

Every ③ assumption in that family was inherited, and he said that was the definition of one. Their ④ assumption was that the field had always been theirs, and the map said otherwise; an assumption, my mother said, is the only kind of knowledge that gets stronger the longer nobody looks. She said nobody had looked in eleven years.

My grandmother had ⑤ assumptions of her own, nine of them, and she said six out loud and kept three. The ⑥ assumption, meaning the act of taking something as true and not the thing taken, is the cheapest way to be certain; an assumption, she said, is a conclusion that has agreed to skip the work. She said the work is where the truth is.

By 1981 the  assumption had become a letter, and the letter had become a survey, and the survey had become nine pages. The ⑦ assumption of the job, he said in June, was the part nobody thanked him for; an assumption, my father said, is either a mistake you make or a duty you take on, and the word serves both. He said he had made one and taken on the other.

The  assumption I remember is the one about the wall, which turned out to be nine feet out. An ⑧ assumption, he said in 1984, is the only thing in the world that is true until somebody writes it down; every assumption, he said, survives on being too obvious to check. He said that was the whole of the law.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 假定；假设（一个具体的假定）
B. n. 假定（指那个信念，与实物相对）
C. n. 假定（指全家继承下来的那种）
D. 固定搭配：make an assumption 作出假定
E. n. （复数 assumptions）多个假定、想法
F. n. 假定（指“把某事当真”这一行为）
G. n. 承担；就任（职务、责任）
H. n. 假定（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The assumption, meaning the belief and not the wall
The assumption, meaning the act of taking something as true

answers.why: make an assumption 意为“作出假定”，1979 年父亲对一道墙作出了一个假定，认为那是他的墙，结果赔进去九年和一道栅栏。
assumption 指“那个信念”，与实物（墙）相对，这个假定从 1961 年起就是错的，却没人检验过。
assumption 指全家继承下来的那种假定，那一家人里每一个假定都是继承来的，他说这就是假定的定义。
assumption 意为“一个具体的假定”，他们的假定是那块地一直是他们的，而地图说的不是这样。
assumptions 为复数，意为“多个假定、想法”，祖母有自己的九个假定，说出六个，留下三个。
assumption 指“把某事当真”这一行为，而不是被当真的那件事，它是获得确定最便宜的办法。
assumption 意为“承担、就任（职务、责任）”，他说承担这份工作是没有人谢他的那一部分。
assumption 为抽象总称，泛指“假定这种东西”，他说假定是世界上唯一在有人把它写下来之前都成立的东西。
